name: Insight
idea: A compact viewing aperture makes observation the identifying feature.
graphic: An enlarged aperture creates a window into a real place. Use one crop per composition, with a broad quiet field around it.
risk: The optical mark needs a final distinctiveness check. Refine the aperture and outer contour before producing master vectors.

name: Assurance
idea: A broad protective upper form holds a clear line of sight above a compact base.
graphic: Use a broad upper curve and an open interval. Carry that geometry into crops and separators without repeating rows of little symbols.
risk: The protected-view symbol can suggest an eye or canopy. Keep the two parts consistent and verify recognition at small sizes.

name: Vigil
idea: An upright opening and observed point create a firm, watchful presence.
graphic: Use an offset plane and a generous opening. Keep the composition anchored to a steady vertical edge; one lemon detail draws attention.
risk: The upright mark may evoke camera hardware. It is a surveillance concept, not a claim that NIVRA manufactures a camera.
